title: Anime Universe
subtitle: Stories that changed how I think
description: Anime is more than entertainment. It is a lens through which I have learned resilience, empathy, discipline, and the courage to question everything. Each world in this collection represents a philosophy, an emotion, or a lesson that reshaped how I see my own path.
quotes: The stories we love become part of who we are.
Every protagonist begins as an outcast.
Growth happens when you refuse to give up.
The strongest characters are the ones who feel the most.
